name: DataAudit
rows: Field Definitions and Data Quality Audit
ASSET, DEP, EQ, LNLSGR, LNRE, P9ASSET, NAASSET, ROA, RBCRWAJ all complete
All 746 financial rows match exactly one institution
No mismatches between financial and institution STALP
Sum of all assets including cash, loans, securities, bank premises. Excludes off-balance-sheet. Unit: thousands USD
Sum of all deposits including demand, money market, savings, time deposits. Unit: thousands USD
Total equity capital including preferred/common stock, surplus, undivided profits. Unit: thousands USD
Gross loans and leases. Unit: thousands USD
Loans secured by real estate. Unit: thousands USD
Loans 90+ days past due and still accruing. Unit: thousands USD
Loans placed on nonaccrual status. Unit: thousands USD
Net income after taxes (annualized) as percent of average total assets. Unit: percent (already in % form)
Risk-based capital ratio under Prompt Corrective Action. Unit: percent (already in % form)
Overdue/nonaccrual asset proxy rate. Not a regulatory rating. Unit: percent
Real estate loan concentration. Unit: percent
Equity to assets ratio. Unit: percent
All monetary fields (ASSET, DEP, EQ, LNLSGR, LNRE, P9ASSET, NAASSET) are in thousands of USD
ROA and RBCRWAJ are already in percent form in source data; do not multiply by 100
Already annualized in source; do not re-annualize
Excluded from ratio calculations; not filled with zero
Snapshot as of data date; cannot be used to infer historical operating status or backfill
Not primary keys; use CERT for identification
